_metadata.name: Stanford Health Care Discharge Summary (Template A, exact)
_metadata.style: Exact reproduction of the SHC 'Discharge Summary' Epic shell. Each free-text '***' blank in the shell is a single composed text field (restructure.py stitches the underlying standardized fields into it); sections the shell labels (Hospitalization Details, Lab panels, Meds, Follow Up, Best Practice) stay structured. A catch-all at the end holds anything with no native slot.
_metadata.based_on: Stanford Hospital and Clinics 'Discharge Summary' Epic template (Template contents.pdf)
_metadata.content_parity_note: Native (composed + structured) fields consume a set of standardized paths; the catch-all holds the rest. Consumed ∪ catch-all = the full standardized field set, identical to template_B_exact.
_metadata.field_types: A field may be: mapped (drawn from one standardized path), 'static' (fixed boilerplate), 'composed' (free-text stitched from several standardized paths), or a 'catch_all' section (all remaining fields).
_metadata.null_convention: Use JSON null for any field absent from the source note.

hospitalization_details.description: Encounter and care-team details (labeled fields in the shell).

attending_contact_info.static: Stanford Hospital page operator at 650-723-4000 and page the attending physician.

reason_for_hospitalization.description: Free-text '***' blank: chief complaint, admitting diagnosis, and brief HPI.

reason.example: Shortness of breath. Community-acquired pneumonia. 64M with 3 days of cough and dyspnea.

summary_of_hospital_course.description: Free-text '***' blank: narrative course and response to treatment.

summary.example: Admitted for pneumonia, treated with IV antibiotics. Clinically improved with resolution of hypoxia.

discharge_plan_by_issue.description: Free-text '***' blank: final diagnoses, plan by issue, and consultant input.

plan.example: Community-acquired pneumonia; acute hypoxic respiratory failure; COPD exacerbation. Pneumonia: IV then oral antibiotics. Pulmonology consulted for effusion.

discharge_exam.description: Free-text '***' blank: condition, vitals, functional and mental status, pain.

exam.example: Stable. BP 124/78, HR 72, afebrile, SpO2 96% RA. Ambulating independently. Alert and oriented x3. Pain well controlled.

laboratory_studies.description: Labeled lab panels in the shell (CBC, Electrolytes, Glucose, Coagulation, LFTs, Cardiac, Other). Grouped by restructure.py.

laboratory.description: Lab values grouped into SHC panels.

pending_labs.description: Tests ordered but not resulted at discharge (labeled slot).

pending.description: Each entry has test, ordered_date, expected_location, action_needed.

imaging.description: Free-text '***' blank: imaging, pathology, and other studies.

imaging.example: CXR (2024-05-01): Right lower lobe consolidation. EKG: Normal sinus rhythm.

medications.description: Each entry has name, dose, route, frequency, indication.

discharge_orders.description: Free-text '@DISCHARGEPROC@' slot: activity, diet, wound care, monitoring, equipment, other.

orders.example: Activity as tolerated. Regular diet. Return if fever or worsening dyspnea.

appointments.description: Each entry has date, time, provider, department, phone.

recommendations.example: Follow up with PCP in 1 week.

best_practice_information.description: SHC best-practice block (labeled items + static footers).

cardiac_quality_attestation.static: BEST PRACTICE for patients with AMI or Heart Failure: quality cardiac topics reviewed and documented.

code_status.description: Code status / goals of care if documented

advance_directives.description: Proxy, living will, POLST if documented

support_services.description: Home health, VNA, PT/OT, case management

smoking_advisory.static: Patient has been advised to quit if currently smoking or to remain tobacco-free if quit within the last 12 months.

referring_physician_portal.static: Referring physicians can access information about the care provided to their patients at Stanford Hospital and Clinics using a secure, web-based portal called PRISM. Visit http://prism.stanfordmedicine.org for more details and to apply for a user account.

additional_clinical_information.description: Catch-all: note-derived facts with no native SHC slot (demographics beyond MRN, PMH, patient education). Filled by restructure.py so content matches template_B_exact.
